events.title: Provider earnings move to SN25
events.detail: Earnings from contracts settled after this cutoff are paid through SN25. Legacy USDC payouts cover only earlier earnings.

events.title: Version 1 contracts deployed
events.detail: Eight deployment steps on Bittensor's EVM, in blocks 9,239,983 to 9,240,067. The coordinator, created at 18:08 UTC, starts epoch 0.

sources.label: Reserve sink linked to the coordinator, block 9,240,039
Vault linked to the coordinator, block 9,240,049

events.title: Network operator 1 registered
events.detail: The governance Safe registers the UR operator, network operator 1, and its pool, SN25 UID 169.

sources.label: Registration through the governance Safe, block 9,240,168

events.title: Version 1 validator activated
events.detail: SN25's sole validator, UID 1, publishes its activation for epoch 1 on chain.

events.title: Weekly epochs scheduled
events.detail: The governance Safe sets 7-day epochs of 50,400 blocks from epoch 1.

sources.label: Epoch schedule through the governance Safe, block 9,240,407

events.title: Network operator settlement switched on
events.detail: The network operator's servers switch on SN25 mainnet settlement.

events.title: Signed client-key registration live
events.detail: The first providers register their client keys with a signature for SN25.

events.title: Epoch 1 begins: the first payout epoch
events.detail: The first weekly payout epoch, and the one the version 1 validator activated for, starts at block 9,247,228.

events.title: Last USDC payout batch
events.detail: The last batch of legacy USDC provider payouts.

events.title: Bittensor runtime 478 on mainnet
events.detail: The chain upgrades again, after runtime 477 on October 12. The settlement v2 contracts passed their rehearsal on runtime 478.

events.title: Settlement v2 start moved to epoch 3
events.detail: The subnet owner moves the start of settlement v2 from epoch 2 to epoch 3.

events.title: Gas policy for settlement v2 in place
events.detail: The network operator's servers load the gas policy for settlement v2's epoch closes.

events.title: Settlement v2 release checks
events.detail: The rollout dates that follow hold if the settlement v2 release passes its final checks by the morning of October 16.

events.title: Network operator services updated, v2 off
events.detail: During the day, the network operator's services move to the settlement v2 release, with v2 still switched off.

events.title: Epoch 1 closes on version 1
events.detail: The close window is 120 blocks, from block 9,297,628 to 9,297,748. The epoch 1 payout root is due by block 9,298,828, around 22:09 UTC.

events.title: Connect service updated, v2 off
events.detail: The network operator's connect service follows its other services, ahead of the validator.

events.title: Settlement v2 validator starts, v2 off
events.detail: The validator runs its new release on unchanged settings, after the connect service.

events.title: Settlement v2 contracts deployed
events.detail: vault2, which holds the funds, and STSettlement2 are on chain beside the unchanged version 1 contracts. Deploying them does not activate settlement v2: the v2 pool must also be registered.

events.title: First version 1 claims (epoch 1)
events.detail: The epoch 1 payout root can finalize from block 9,312,028 at the earliest, and claims open then. As explained above, version 1 does not pay every miner.

events.title: Validator adopts its settlement v2 settings
events.detail: Kept clear of the epoch 1 finalization on the evening of October 18.

events.title: Network operator switches to the v2 contracts
events.detail: The network operator's servers switch to the settlement v2 contracts on October 19, and checks run on October 20. Apps pin vault2 from October 18 to 20.

events.title: Settlement v2 not registered for epoch 3
events.detail: No v2 pool was registered in the window, blocks 9,333,628 to 9,340,828, so epoch 3 stays on version 1. Registration cannot activate an epoch that has already begun.

events.title: Epoch 3 begins on version 1
events.detail: Epoch 3 starts at block 9,348,028 without a v2 pool registered, so version 1 settles it. Epoch 2 closes on version 1, with its payout root due by around 22:09 UTC.

events.title: Settlement v2 pool registration, pending
events.detail: The governance Safe registers the v2 pool for epoch 4, after the final production checks. This is the activation, and it must finalize before block 9,398,428. At finalized block 9,354,702, on October 24 at 16:40 UTC, the pool was not yet registered.

events.title: Version 1 claims (epoch 2)
events.detail: The epoch 2 payout root can finalize from block 9,362,428 at the earliest. The same version 1 limit applies.

events.title: Target: settlement v2 active, epoch 4 begins
events.detail: From block 9,398,428, if the v2 pool registration has finalized by then. If it has not, epoch 4 also stays on version 1, and a new date will be set. Epoch 3 still closes on version 1, with its payout root due by around 22:25 UTC.

events.title: Last version 1 claims (epoch 3), if v2 starts with epoch 4
events.detail: The epoch 3 payout root can finalize from block 9,412,828 at the earliest. The same version 1 limit applies.

events.title: Modern provider gate turns on
events.detail: Quality and Speed admit only providers verified as modern. The gate turns on automatically at 00:00 UTC, two weeks later than the October 21 first planned.

events.title: First settlement v2 close and commit
events.detail: If settlement v2 starts with epoch 4: epoch 4 ends at block 9,448,828, and the first v2 ledger root is due by block 9,450,028.

events.title: First settlement v2 claims, earliest
events.detail: The first v2 root can finalize 14,400 blocks after its commit, from block 9,463,228 to 9,464,428 at the earliest, and claims follow once it has. Open challenges, a late or invalid root, or delayed finalization can push claims later.
